Thursday, October 14, 2021 
 593 
 
 
LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY OF MANITOBA 
__________________________ 
 
VOTES AND PROCEEDINGS   No. 82 
 
THIRD SESSION, FORTY-SECOND LEGISLATURE 
 
PRAYER  10:00 O'CLOCK A.M. 
 
Ms. FONTAINE moved: 
 
THAT Bill (No. 207) – The Abortion Protest Buffer Zone Act/Loi sur les zones d'interdiction des 
manifestations contre l'avortement, be now read a Second Time and be referred to a Committee of this 
House. 
 
And a debate arising, 
 
And Ms. FONTAINE having spoken, 
 
And Mr. MARTIN, Ms. NAYLOR, Ms. FONTAINE, Hon. Mr. GERRARD, Mr. JOHNSTON, MLA 
ASAGWARA and Mr. NESBITT having questioned the Minister, 
 
And the debate continuing, 
 
And Mr. MARTIN and MLA MARCELINO having spoken, 
 
In accordance sub-rule 23(6), the debate was interrupted at 10:35 a.m. to deal with the Concurrence 
and Third Reading of Bill (No. 232). 
 
In accordance with sub -rule 24(1), the concurrence and Third Reading debate on Bill (No. 232) 
was interrupted in order to put the Question on Selected Bill (No. 207) at 10:50 a.m. 
 
And the Question being put.  It was negatived, on the following division: 
 
YEA

Mr. MOSES moved: 
 
THAT Bill (No. 232) – The Emancipation Day Act/Loi sur le Jour de l'émancipation, reported from 
the Standing Committee on Social and Economic Development, be concurred in and be now read for a 
Third Time and passed. 
 
And a debate arising, 
 
And Messrs. MOSES and GUENTER having spoken, 
 
In accordance with the Sessional Order agreed to by the House on October 6, 2021, the debate was 
interrupted at 10:55 a.m. to put the Question. 
 
And the Question being put.  It was agreed to, on the following division:
